market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$101.79 May 4. To print a LOW at $90 in May requires ~11.6% decline. Plausible if Iran ceasefire holds and Hormuz reopens, releasing geopolitical premium of ~$10-15. Yet OPEC+ typically defends prices and demand seasonality is improving into summer. Roughly even-money skewed slightly down.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of Hormuz normalization and OPEC+ supply response.
